rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides security verification tools for AI agent skills through the Skvil network. Supports skill verification by SHA-256 hash with reputation scores and risk levels, community scan submission, on-chain certification checking (V1 through Gold levels via Solana SPL Memo transactions), and suspicious skill reporting. Includes automated Crucible behavioral analysis with static analysis across 32+ pattern categories and AI-driven triage.
